writeup: TIC 349725115 is a newly discovered eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of 32.44 days. The primary eclipse causes the system to dim by 16.87 percent, while no secondary eclipse has been detected. This system was not found in any of six existing variable-star catalogs, making it a genuine new discovery. The signal was detected with high confidence, yielding a detection significance of 177.1 and confirmed through difference imaging analysis. The alternating eclipse depths indicate the binary's true period is double the initial measurement, a characteristic signature confirmed through rigorous data quality checks. This discovery demonstrates how systematic surveys continue to reveal previously unknown stellar systems.
